json_schema.title: Catalytic Geometry uploaded runtime reaction template
json_schema.description: Agent-created file shape. Worker overwrites template_id, version, status. Cross-field min<=max, distinct atoms/check IDs and actual structure/evidence are checked by worker, not this schema.

predicate.description: Nested supported check excluding ensemble_occupancy; see runtime validation for type-specific fields.

template_binding.notes: Live FastAPI currently requires this path. JSON must contain exactly mapping_keys with 1-1000 role mappings; each role targets an upstream key or chain/residue location. Do not invent dummy mappings.

json_schema.title: Catalytic Geometry uploaded template binding
json_schema.description: Live FastAPI currently requires a path to this file. Do not invent a binding when no real role mapping is needed.

mapping_path.notes: Optional. CSV required columns candidate_id,mapping_key,chain_id,residue_number; insertion_code optional. JSON keyed by candidate ID then mapping key to location. Candidate ID matches structure basename. Node route requires JSON; CSV was explicitly rejected in live testing.

json_schema.title: Catalytic Geometry candidate mapping JSON
json_schema.description: Candidate IDs must match input structure filename stems. Runtime additionally checks duplicate keys, actual structure references and role resolution.
